title: Make worker turns immune to missing deps, PATH Node and red-first evidence
body:
Outcome: a worker turn never fails for environment reasons: `krn worker start` installs dependencies in a fresh worktree (or refuses before the turn with the exact command), runs the sandbox `--check`/`--observer` commands with the Node from `.node-version` (not PATH Node 26.12.1), and the report schema keeps intended red-first base runs out of `failing check` lines.
Evidence 2026-11-05: t-47enn80 worker start exit 64 "dependencies missing: run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile"; its next turn exited 4 listing two "failing checks" that were the intended red-at-base runs (.krn/runs/lead/t-47enn80/rounds/001/report.json); t-q8j6r5c compact worker reported partial with blocker "Node v26.12.1, strict suite tests need 24.22.1" while all checks passed on Node 24 (.krn/runs/lead/t-q8j6r5c/worker-compact.log).
Proof: driver tests for a missing node_modules worktree, PATH Node mismatch, and a report whose red-first entries are not counted as failing.
